name: gimbal_arm
description: Camera gimbal arm 120 long, tapering from 40 wide at the motor end to 24 wide at the clamp end (tangent R arcs). Motor end: D30 boss 20 tall with a spherical-cap (R40) top, D12 through bore with 1 mm chamfer. Arm web 6 thick with three triangular lightening pockets (R2 corners) 4 mm deep, perimeter rib 3 wide at full 10 mm height. Clamp end: 12 thick lug with a D8 through hole and a 1.5 wide clamp slit.
